parse_demo_options: parse command line arguments for FrankMocap demo using DemoOptions parse method
configure_body_mocap_checkpoints: configure SMPL and SMPLX pretrained checkpoint paths for body motion capture
set_input_output_paths: set input video path and output directory for mocap predictions
configure_hand_mocap_options: configure hand mocap view type and crop type for hand pose estimation
set_renderer_and_display_options: set renderer type and display options for visualizing mocap results
